newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends flat at 248.80-249.20 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends flat at 248.80-249.20 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed around 248.80-249.20 per dollar, in a narrower spread and almost unchanged from the 248.50-249.30 rate in the morning, after thin interbank forex trade, dealers said.

"Interbank trade remained thin throughout the day," a dealer said, adding that the lev's stability was due to very low foreign currency demand and existing supply from the central bank and some final clients.
The central bank bid for dollars at 248.50 levs and offered them at 249.00/50 throughout the day, dealers said.
